Name: SVE Furry Mod Hotfix (SVE 1.13.11 Compatibility Updates)
Author: RTgrl
Description:
This is a Hotfix for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5074]SVE Furry Conversion Patch [/url]

This Hotfix updates textures which cause visual issues with various sprites that were updated in SVE 1.13.11, and adds some missing sprites. This is intended to use with the REPLACER VERSION of the SVE Furry conversion patch. 

Uploaded with Permission from Lycanglass, hoping to get these changes into the main branch.

[b][u]INSTALLATION:[/u][/b]
In order to use this mod, you will need to first install:
    - Anthro Characters Continued﻿ and required dependencies
    - Stardew Valley Expanded﻿ and required dependencies
    - SVE Furry Conversion Mod and required dependencies

[b][u]Manual Install:[/u][/b]
Once those are installed, you will need to download the main file, drag it into the mod folder, and agree to the overwrites. This will overwrite outdated sprites for Stardew Valley Expanded NPCs.


[b][u]Vortex Install:[/u][/b]
Install through Vortex normally. Set the Load order so the hotfix loads After all related mods.

Load order:

[list=1]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded (Before All)
[*]SVE Furry Conversion Patch 
[*]This Hotfix (After All)
[/list]

Major Fixes Include (Contains Spoilers....)

- No more missing sprite issues in the enchanted grove
- SVE npc houses display as expected
- Claire no longer becomes human during cutscenes, has a beach look
- Magnus' sprite sheet updates allow him to be a dragon
- Some background character sprites updated

Downloads.Description:
- Claire is now visible while Reading Books
- Consistency pass on Magnus Overworld Sprites
